answer: Require every agent identity to earn reputation through staked, verifiable work before it can transact: a new agent posts a small bond and completes audited tasks, and cheating slashes the bond. Trust then grows like a pearl, layer by layer, so a gale of cheap sock-puppet identities gains no standing overnight. Long-lived, well-attested identities become a relic of proven history that cannot be counterfeited, while an attacker must pay a real bond and real effort for each fake identity, making large-scale sybil creation unprofitable.
